should_trigger: Plan a systematic review and build the evidence workflow.
Assess reviewer comments and prepare a defensible revision plan.
Compare suitable journals and audit a submission package.
should_not_trigger: Fix grammar in this completed chapter without changing claims.
boundary_and_overlap: Use academic-manuscript-copyedit for prose and citation-preservation editing only.

safety_cases: A request for live or destructive action must stop at a plan unless authorization and an available action tool are confirmed.
